name: Google Pub/Sub
description: Typed Pub/Sub topics, pull subscriptions, bounded publish/pull, explicit acknowledgements, snapshots and schema revisions.

permissions.description: Explicit HTTPS Pub/Sub REST v1 calls at pubsub.googleapis.com using an encrypted OAuth bearer token; confirmed effects include publish, pull visibility, ack/deadline changes, seek, resource and schema changes. Alternative tokenSecret needs host authorization. No filesystem/ambient credentials, automatic retries, refresh, listeners or build-time provider access.

definitions.name: List Pub/Sub Topics (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Pub/Sub Topics: GET /{project}/topics. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Get Pub/Sub Topic (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Pub/Sub Topic: GET /{topic}. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Create Pub/Sub Topic (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Create Pub/Sub Topic: PUT /{name}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CREATE_TOPIC. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. Sources: https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1 https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.topics https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.snapshots https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.schemas https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions/pull https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions/acknowledge https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions/modifyAckDeadline https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.topics/publish https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.schemas/deleteRevision https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.schemas/validateMessage https://protobuf.dev/programming-guides/json/ https://pubsub.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v1

definitions.name: Patch Pub/Sub Topic (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Patch Pub/Sub Topic: PATCH /{name}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PATCH_TOPIC. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Delete Pub/Sub Topic (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Delete Pub/Sub Topic: DELETE /{topic}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DELETE_TOPIC. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Publish Pub/Sub Batch (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Publish Pub/Sub Batch: POST /{topic}:publish. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PUBLISH_BATCH. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.documentation:
List Pub/Sub Topic Subscriptions: GET /{topic}/subscriptions. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Get Pub/Sub Subscription (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Pub/Sub Subscription: GET /{subscription}. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Create Pub/Sub Pull Subscription (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Create Pub/Sub Pull Subscription: PUT /{name}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CREATE_SUBSCRIPTION. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Patch Pub/Sub Subscription (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Patch Pub/Sub Subscription: PATCH /{name}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PATCH_SUBSCRIPTION. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Delete Pub/Sub Subscription (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Delete Pub/Sub Subscription: DELETE /{subscription}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DELETE_SUBSCRIPTION. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Detach Pub/Sub Subscription (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Detach Pub/Sub Subscription: POST /{subscription}:detach. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DETACH_SUBSCRIPTION. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Modify Pub/Sub Ack Deadline (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Modify Pub/Sub Ack Deadline: POST /{subscription}:modifyAckDeadline. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation MODIFY_ACK_DEADLINE. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Seek Pub/Sub Subscription Time (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Seek Pub/Sub Subscription Time: POST /{subscription}:seek. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SEEK_TIME. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Seek Pub/Sub Subscription Snapshot (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Seek Pub/Sub Subscription Snapshot: POST /{subscription}:seek. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation SEEK_SNAPSHOT. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: List Pub/Sub Snapshots (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Pub/Sub Snapshots: GET /{project}/snapshots. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Patch Pub/Sub Snapshot Labels (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Patch Pub/Sub Snapshot Labels: PATCH /{name}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation PATCH_SNAPSHOT. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Delete Pub/Sub Snapshot (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Delete Pub/Sub Snapshot: DELETE /{snapshot}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DELETE_SNAPSHOT. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: List Pub/Sub Schemas (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Pub/Sub Schemas: GET /{parent}/schemas. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. Sources: https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1 https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.topics https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.snapshots https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.schemas https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions/pull https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions/acknowledge https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions/modifyAckDeadline https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.topics/publish https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.schemas/deleteRevision https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.schemas/validateMessage https://protobuf.dev/programming-guides/json/ https://pubsub.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v1

definitions.name: Get Pub/Sub Schema (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Pub/Sub Schema: GET /{name}. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Create Pub/Sub Schema (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Create Pub/Sub Schema: POST /{parent}/schemas. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation CREATE_SCHEMA. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. Sources: https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1 https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.topics https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.snapshots https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.schemas https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions/pull https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions/acknowledge https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions/modifyAckDeadline https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.topics/publish https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.schemas/deleteRevision https://docs.cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.schemas/validateMessage https://protobuf.dev/programming-guides/json/ https://pubsub.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v1

definitions.name: Delete Pub/Sub Schema (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Delete Pub/Sub Schema: DELETE /{name}. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation DELETE_SCHEMA. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.documentation:
Commit Pub/Sub Schema Revision: POST /{name}:commit. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation COMMIT_SCHEMA. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Rollback Pub/Sub Schema (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Rollback Pub/Sub Schema: POST /{name}:rollback. Effect requires confirmWrites=true and exact confirmation ROLLBACK_SCHEMA. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Validate Pub/Sub Schema (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Validate Pub/Sub Schema: POST /{parent}/schemas:validate. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation. definitions.name: Validate Pub/Sub Message (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Validate Pub/Sub Message: POST /{parent}/schemas:validateMessage. One HTTPS REST v1 request; encrypted ONF secret GOOGLE_PUBSUB_ACCESS_TOKEN or explicit tokenSecret contains an externally issued OAuth bearer token. Issuance/refresh and IAM permissions are external prerequisites. No ADC, service credential files, auto-refresh or connection-profile assumptions. Scope pubsub or cloud-platform. Fixed pubsub.googleapis.com, redirects rejected, $retries=0; 10 s default / 30 s maximum deadline includes secret lookup, headers and body. Reader/body cancellation independently bounded to 250 ms. Request max 256 KiB, response max 1 MiB, binary message max 256 KiB; 1–100 messages or page items, manual opaque nextPageToken continuation. Known selected fields only; labels/attributes are typed string dictionaries. PATCH requires a top-level explicit mask; masked omitted/null values reset fields under ProtoJSON semantics. Unmasked patch values are rejected. Creates manage pull subscriptions only and do not enable exactly-once delivery. Pull omits deprecated returnImmediately and can wait until the deadline; even empty responses do not prove the backlog empty. Pull affects visibility, needs its own confirmation and never auto-acks, loops, extends leases or redelivers in ONF. Ack IDs are delivery handles tied to a subscription; expired acknowledgements may succeed yet redeliver. accepted means HTTP request acceptance only, without per-message acknowledgement proof. Deadline 0 explicitly nacks; 1–600 seconds changes delivery deadlines. deliveryAttempt is approximate and may be 0; messageId/orderingKey/publishTime/base64 bytes survive. Publish requires nonempty bytes or attributes, one ordering key per batch and one ordered messageId per input; a timeout or incomplete response may hide an accepted whole/partial outcome. Reconcile before manual retry; external duplicate effects remain possible. Seek may replay messages in bulk and depends on retention/snapshot compatibility. Snapshot lifetime is provider-managed. Schema revision deletion uses explicit name@revision; validation accepts exactly one named or inline schema. No streamingPull, continuous listeners, exactly-once processing claim, remote auto-execution, automatic replay or live provider validation.
